- Can you confirm whether the property can commit to a single-floor stack for the 24 executive rooms we reserved (or at least keep them within contiguous floors)? Our execs prefer contiguous floors for security and shuttle routing.

Hi Soojin,

Appreciate the detail. Quick answers below and a couple of options attached: hotel_block_map.pdf and a rooming addendum draft.

- Contiguous floors: We can hold a contiguous stack on floors 10–12 for 24 rooms. Final allocation will be confirmed 21 days prior to arrival. We can move to a firm 14-day release if Redwood signs the attached addendum.
- Bedding conversion: We can convert 6 queen rooms to twin setup; rollaways are available in suites only (limit of 4). We have three ADA suites per floor; highlight the guest names needing ADA and we’ll lock those in.
- Preboard table: We offer a complimentary preboard table for groups over 20 if the master bill contract is signed and the group uses in-house catering for at least one meal. Otherwise there’s a $250 flat setup fee (includes two staff and table signage).
- Master bill vs individual folios: Per our policy, the master bill requires a signed addendum. I attached the draft. For individual folios we’ll need credit card authorizations for incidentals.

Attached: hotel_block_map.pdf, hotel-final-rooming-addendum.docx

Let me know if you want me to lock the 10–12 floor stack now.
